verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud documents opportunity management and pipeline management, including 'complete visibility into your pipeline' and 'Advanced Forecast & Pipeline Management', so deal tracking along a pipeline is a first-party capability. The pack never describes a visual board view, configurable stages, or drag-and-drop updates, so only the core of deal tracking is evidenced. missing for 10: documented visual/kanban pipeline view, customizable deal stages, drag-and-drop stage updates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
